responsibility: Coordinates backend optimization and object emission work across codegen units, defining module emission configuration, managing asynchronous codegen and LTO worker communication, collecting compiled artifacts, and producing final codegen results and incremental work products.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `traits/write.rs`, which only specifies the backend contract for write/optimization stages, this file contains the crate’s concrete backend-agnostic orchestration for those stages: module configuration, worker coordination, artifact collection, and submission of codegen/LTO work.
